settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking link by email and SMS.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer easy 7-day returns on most products. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: Yes, COD is available on eligible orders across India.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within 3–7 business days depending on your location.
